source_record.description:
Be bold, think big and grow with us!
 
At MARKT-PILOT, we're on a mission to create real value for the industrial manufacturing industry and set a new standard in the spare parts business. As a fast-growing B2B scale-up, we enable comprehensive market transparency for the first time. MP ONE, our unified Pricing Performance platform, is at the heart of that: giving manufacturers the clarity to understand their market, the confidence to price decisively, and the control to measure what matters. To achieve this, we combine strong momentum with clear intention: we learn quickly, test constantly, and trust our teams with the autonomy and flexibility to turn ideas into outcomes.
 
It's an environment shaped by hands-on builders who challenge the status quo, take ownership and are driven to solve real problems with bold thinking and action. Join a team that moves fast, grows smarter every step, and succeeds together.
 
Are you ready? 🚀
 
Join us as a (Senior) Platform Engineer (f/m/d) and help us evolve.

Your Mission
  • Own reliability and performance across our cloud platform: define and drive SLOs, monitoring, and incident response in a fast-moving production environment
  • Lead complex Azure cloud deployments end to end, from planning and design through rollout and operations
  • Build and evolve automation and infrastructure-as-code so our platform stays reliable, secure, and easy to operate at scale
  • Champion platform tooling with other teams. Success is measured by adoption, not just delivery, so you work directly with teams to embed what you build
  • Partner with our Cloud Architect and cross-functional teams to shape and deliver the cloud vision and roadmap
  • Act as a Senior engineer who mentors others and multiplies the impact of the whole team

    • Your Skills
  • Deep, hands-on observability and reliability experience: SLOs, monitoring, incident ownership, and modern stacks like Azure Monitor, Datadog, Prometheus, or similar in real production environments
  • Proven experience running Kubernetes (AKS or similar) at meaningful production scale, not just in sandboxes or personal projects
  • Strong Terraform or equivalent IaC background, you automate by default and avoid ClickOps
  • Solid CI/CD pipeline expertise and cloud security fundamentals, including IAM, least privilege, encryption, and compliance
  • Clear track record of driving adoption of the tooling you build across other teams, this is a must-have, not a nice-to-have
  • You aim for technical excellence, but know that shipping 80% today often beats chasing 101% forever
  • You do not wait for permission, you take initiative, drive work to completion, and stand behind the solutions you deliver
    •  
    Don't tick all the boxes yet? That's more opportunity for growth. Contact us anyway, and let's grow together.

    Your Benefits
  • Our modern and open scale-up culture gives you the freedom to unleash your creativity within a dynamic and agile team. 💡 
  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Feedback here is exactly what it should be - an essential part of your work. 📈 
  • We invest in your growth: Discover our Learning & Development programs - including an L&D budget! 🌱 
  • Flexible working hours and the option to work hybrid. Remote is also possible.
  • Rest is important too - 30 days of vacation 🏖️ 
  • Travel by Train: Even MARKT-PILOTS take the train! We subsidize your monthly Deutschland-Ticket! 🚆 
  • Job bikes for those who prefer to travel on two wheels! 🚴‍♀️ 
  • Crew-Love: Look forward to regular team events, exciting gaming sessions, and much more. 🎮️ 
  • Stay Healthy: With a discounted WELLPASS membership and healthy snacks, you can always recharge your batteries. 🍏 
  • Corporate Benefits: Discover a variety of attractive offers from top brands with exclusive discounts. 🛒
    • Awarded as a Top-5%-Employer for the 5th time in a row. Fly with us @MARKT-PILOT! 🚀
